cards.title: Review work became the product
cards.shift: The tool does not remove writing work. It moves the scarce work from drafting to deciding what can be trusted.
cards.basis: The source claims faster production while repeatedly adding review and approval stages.
cards.action: Measure reviewer time and correction rate separately from raw generation speed.
cards.boundary: This does not establish that the tool reduces total output quality.

judgments.reason: Clear, grounded reframing of the bottleneck.
